auxiliary_preparation.basis: Reconstructed from three completed unique display caches, each requiring 19 forward and 19 reciprocal frequency batches on both 768 and 1536 nodes. Each worker completed its one unique state before failing to write the per-job prepared receipt. Recovery confirms all six requested duplicate views reuse those caches.
auxiliary_preparation.limitation: Original detailed work ledgers and per-worker timings were not persisted; these batch counts are reconstructed, not measured ledger exports.
